title: AI chat
description: AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model.
when: Every AI conversation in a Semi app (assistant beside a workspace, help over a modal).

instead.need: A different layout of the same parts
instead.use: ChatPanel + ChatView + the message parts (Chat messages doc)

a11y: The list announces one message per finished answer; Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, IME composition is safe; placement="screen" is a dialog where Escape closes only the chat.
notes: The model picker goes in toolbar (ChatModelPicker); provider and model lists are app data.

examples.title: Assistant beside a workspace
examples.description: Type and press Enter: a fake assistant streams an answer; Stop, retry and new chat work.

examples.title: Over a modal
examples.description: placement="screen" opens the assistant as a dialog over everything; Escape closes only the chat.
